newsitem.title: USA: JTS completes line of credit.
newsitem.headline: JTS completes line of credit.

text.p: JTS Corp said it completed a $30 million working capital line of credit from The CIT Group, a company of Daiichi Kangyo Bank and Chase Manhattan Corp and a $25 million foreign accounts receivable line of credit from RBC Trade Finance Inc, a wholly owned unit of Royal Bank of Canada.

The lending arrangements are intended to provide JTS with additional capital to expand its production efforts to ramp the new high performance Champion Family of 3.5-inch disk drives for the desktop market and the Nordic Family of 3.0-inch disk drives for the notebook market.
